readings.basis: I2 frame objective (original ambition); worst 10 s active window

readings.limit: > 29 Hz per seat, no host pump stall

alignment.limit: Logcat stamps are milliseconds; the anchor is the request line minus its totalMs.

waits: 15242 15256 I .deathride.per: WaitForGcToComplete blocked RunEmptyCheckpoint on ProfileSaver for 12.236ms

runtimeAllocation.limit: Whole process (ART runtime stats from /profile), between the second and the last profile fetch.

deviceCounters.limit: Clock ticks of 10 ms between two reads around the probe (app threads that exited during the run are missing).

limits: Profiled arm (/profile every 10 s). Off-CPU time (work - thread CPU) says the render thread was not running, not why: a scheduler trace separates runnable (preempted) from sleeping (blocked). GC overlap is time overlap, not cause. Not optical latency or owner feel.
